title: SQUAMED domain event envelope v1
description: Wire format of every event published to squamed.domain-events and the per-type topics. Mirrors com.squamed.core.events.DomainEvent. Breaking changes require a new schema version (v2), never an edit to v1.

eventId.description: Unique event id; dedupe/replay key for consumers.

eventType.description: Lowercase dotted domain event name, e.g. patient.created, task.assigned.

occurredAt.description: UTC instant the event was raised.

entityType.description: Domain entity kind the event is about, e.g. patient, task.

entityId.description: Entity the event is about; null for system-level events.

hospitalId.description: Tenant (hospital) scope of the event; null until tenancy backfill (00.04, ADR-13).

payload.description: Free-form per-event-type data; consumers must tolerate unknown keys.

recipientIds.description: Users the event should surface to (in-app notification + realtime push). Empty = broadcast-suppressed.
